lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor forty-four. A hundred and ten megawatts — that's everything this reactor has.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It's the eighth one we've powered up. I've been keeping the list.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: The quarantine list.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The same list, yes. Eight of sixty-one now read as open on their side of it.
lines.beat: the act's cost, stated as bookkeeping

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Hold the anchor, Meridian.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Heavy. They're committing everything.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Eleven years these things ran on their own and we've spent a month taking them apart.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Eleven years of nothing happening. That was them working.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Vasquez. The wave that just spawned isn't routing to us.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Say again?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They've turned. They're facing the ring. They are not interested in you at all.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over. Whatever you're running, it costs more than it's returning right now.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. Keep the ring.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Hold. We do not lose this one.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Clear. Okonkwo — the last two waves never engaged us.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: No. They formed up on the ring and they held. We shot them in the back for four minutes.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Facing what?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The instruments say the ring is drawing about nine megawatts that isn't going anywhere I can find.
lines.beat: the Hollow only ever as an instrument reading — never described

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, we need somebody senior on this channel.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Acknowledged. Proceed to anchor forty-nine.
